_note: Sourced multiplet / satellite envelopes per chemical species, used to build presets for ANY element (presets.multiplet_preset). Each species: peaks [BE eV, area %, FWHM eV]; the first peak is the reference. Values copied from the cited table and checked cell by cell (docs/dev/C0_literature_values.md, section F3 and I). Add elements as data only.

cr2p3_biesinger2011.source: M. C. Biesinger et al., Appl. Surf. Sci. 257 (2011) 2717, Table 1 (monochromatic Al Kα, Kratos Axis Ultra; FWHM at 20 eV pass energy, NiCr2O4 at 10 eV (no 20 eV value printed); adventitious C 1s = 284.8 eV). Cr(0) is LA(1.3,4,5) in the paper, approximated by GL(30); Cr(III) hydroxide BE is for an aged hydroxide (fresh: 577.1 eV); Cr2O3 areas as printed sum to 103 %.

mn2p3_biesinger2011.source: M. C. Biesinger et al., Appl. Surf. Sci. 257 (2011) 2717, Table 3 (monochromatic Al Kα, Kratos Axis Ultra; FWHM at 20 eV pass energy; MnO peak 6 is a shake-up with FWHM 3.5 eV; adventitious C 1s = 284.8 eV). Mn(0) peaks are LA(1.1,3.2,3) in the paper, approximated by GL(30). Pyrolusite omitted: its printed areas sum to 80.1 %.

fe2p3_biesinger2011.source: M. C. Biesinger et al., Appl. Surf. Sci. 257 (2011) 2717, Table 4 (monochromatic Al Kα, Kratos Axis Ultra; FWHM at 10 eV pass energy, FeCr2O4 at 20 eV; adventitious C 1s = 284.8 eV). Fe(0) is LA(1.2,4.8,3) in the paper, approximated by GL(30). Fe3O4 = Fe2+ and Fe3+ sets together (100 %). Printed inconsistencies resolved with the splittings (more accurate than BEs, table footnote a): alpha-Fe2O3 peak 4 712.3 (printed 713.3), alpha-FeOOH peak 4 713.3 (printed 711.2), FeCr2O4 peak 4 712.4 (printed 713.0); gamma-Fe2O3 Δ(3-2) printed 13.0 is 1.0.

co2p3_biesinger2011.source: M. C. Biesinger et al., Appl. Surf. Sci. 257 (2011) 2717, Table 5 (monochromatic Al Kα, Kratos Axis Ultra; FWHM at 20 eV pass energy; adventitious C 1s = 284.8 eV, metals Au 4f7/2 = 83.95 eV). Co(0) peak 1 is LA(1.2,5,5) in the paper; approximated here by GL(30).

ni2p3_biesinger2011.source: M. C. Biesinger et al., Appl. Surf. Sci. 257 (2011) 2717, Table 6 (monochromatic Al Kα, Kratos Axis Ultra; FWHM at 20 eV pass energy; gamma-/beta-NiOOH and NiCr2O4 at 10 eV (20 eV column incomplete or, for NiCr2O4 peak 3, implausible: 7.01 vs 3.91 eV); adventitious C 1s = 284.8 eV, metal Au 4f7/2 = 83.95 eV). Ni(0) = 'new line shape' row, peak 1 LA(1.1,2.2,10) in the paper, approximated by GL(30). beta-NiOOH = Ni3+ and Ni2+ portions together (2:1, 100 %).
